svg.title: Ridham Pansara, cloud and platform engineering
svg.desc: Animated banner: name, a typed rotation of infrastructure commands, and a reconciliation loop moving a change from Git to a healthy cluster.

g.text: Master's student in computer engineering, building cloud
platforms with Kubernetes, Terraform, GitOps and CI/CD.

svg.text: terraform apply # OCI network, OKE cluster, storage
argocd app sync cloudops-insight # GitOps rollout
trivy image --exit-code 1 api # block risky images
aws sts assume-role --external-id … # no stored keys
Open to a master's thesis, internship or working-student role
